verdict.rationale: A developer CLI tool such as a package manager could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this story applies to Bun. Nothing in the evidence pack documents one: the docs cover install, lockfiles, workspaces, audit and pm subcommands, and the llms.txt probe is documentation published for external AI tools, not an assistant inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
